assembly_origin: Authored PEN-F electronic aperture-ring hooks and HSL compatibility layout. Short replayed instructions and original-byte guards derive from the identified stock firmware.
source_scope: Assembly, linker scripts, exact-build manifests, a portable source builder, bounded native probes and contributor camera observations. No vendor image, bulk disassembly or private camera data included.

upstream_tools.license_note: Existing repository and component provenance/licensing notices remain applicable; no new repository-wide license is asserted.

camera_report.source: Direct contributor reports from physical camera testing
confirmed: Electronic aperture-ring control in A and M
Depth of field preview displayed correctly
HSL and aperture together work on camera
Correct f/1.7 ring values on 15 mm, 10-25 mm and 25-50 mm lenses
limits: Exact per-lens firmware revisions and measured iris/exposure data were not supplied
Do not infer universal lens compatibility or guaranteed update recovery
Separate HSL RAW/preview measurements were not supplied
